title: The heist has a job for you, and it isn't the driver's
dek: Twelve questions about how you work a room, a plan and a locked door. Nobody is asking whether you'd actually do it, so be honest.

questions.prompt: The job is in three days. Where are you?

options.label: Rewriting the timeline for the fourth time
At the site, listening to the building
Buying a shirt that fits the lobby
In a van, checking the exits
Talk the guard into a different story
Kill the cameras and keep moving

questions.helper: Across: plan or improvise. Up: invisible or unmissable.

options.label: reads the room before the plan

I'd rather be trusted than feared.

questions.prompt: The one thing you'd never do on a job:

results.name: The Mastermind
results.tagline: You planned this eleven months ago
results.blurb: You are three steps ahead and slightly annoyed that nobody else is. Your plan has a plan, the plan has a contingency, and the contingency has a note about parking. You are rarely wrong and never relaxed.
strengths: Sees the whole board, not the next move
results.watchOut: The plan is not the point. The people executing it are.

results.name: The Safecracker
results.tagline: You listen to the lock, not the alarm
results.blurb: You are the calmest person in the building because you are the only one doing something with your hands. You like problems with a mechanism: a lock, a hinge, a person who can be reasoned with. Everything else is noise.
strengths: Fixes the thing nobody else can touch
Notices detail other people walk past
results.watchOut: Not every problem is a lock. Some need a conversation.

results.name: The Face
results.tagline: You talk your way past the front desk
results.blurb: You have never once needed a fake badge, because you simply behave like you belong. You read a room in four seconds and give it the version of you it wants. It is a craft, and you are very good at it.
strengths: Defuses a situation without touching it
results.watchOut: Charm runs out. Have something real underneath it.

results.name: The Wire
results.blurb: You solve the job before anybody has to be brave. While the others are looking at doors, you're looking at what the building believes about itself. You prefer your crimes at a desk, with a second monitor.
strengths: Finds the way in nobody considered
results.watchOut: A clever route still needs someone to walk it.

results.name: The Wheelman
results.blurb: You are not the plan and you are not the charm; you are the reason everyone gets to argue about it afterwards. You notice exits, timing and the one road that isn't blocked. Waiting is the job, and you're fine with it.
strengths: Reads a route like a map in your head
results.watchOut: Being the exit plan can look like being uninvolved. Say more.

results.name: The Muscle
results.tagline: You're the plan B that works
results.blurb: You are the least complicated person in the room and the one everybody is quietly glad to have. You don't overthink, you don't freeze, and you will absolutely carry the awkward thing down three flights of stairs. Loyalty is your whole method.
results.watchOut: Being dependable makes it easy for people to skip your opinion.

results.name: The Fixer
results.tagline: Knows a guy, and the guy owes them
results.blurb: You are the crew's phone book: the van, the uniform, the guy who can lose a form. You don't crack anything yourself — you make the job possible from the outside and collect favours the way other people collect receipts. Nothing in the plan works without your three phone calls.
strengths: Has a number for every problem
results.watchOut: A favour bank runs dry. Pay one back before the next job.

results.name: The Lookout
results.tagline: Sees the thing everyone else walks past
results.blurb: You take the boring post and make it the reason the job works. Two hours of nothing, then one detail — a car that has been there too long — and everyone is still free because you said it early instead of waiting to be sure.
strengths: Reads a street like a sentence
results.watchOut: Being right quietly goes uncredited. Say what you saw afterwards.

results.name: The Inside Woman
results.tagline: Already works there, already has the badge
results.blurb: You get hired three weeks early and learn the coffee order, the shift change, the door that sticks. Nobody suspects the person who knows where the printer paper lives. It is the longest, dullest, most effective role on the crew, and it is entirely yours.
strengths: Knows the building better than the blueprints
Patient for weeks at a time
results.watchOut: Get too deep in character and even the crew forgets you're a person.

results.name: The Medic
results.tagline: The only one who plans for it going wrong
results.blurb: You come in for the worst night of the job: the cut, the shock, the one who can't walk. You're calm because you rehearsed it, and the crew is braver because they know you're back there with the bag and the headlamp.
strengths: Steady when it is actually bad
results.watchOut: You look after all of them. Book your own check-up.
